items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: We hit an in-muted with Marilyn, Furinella, Liza Jane, Downholm Ray. High Society, Tiger Ray, Clarinet Mamalee.

ctx.x: We played a sliding jim. Was that a famous thing there?
